description: Run a request that guardian_invoke_tool held as ASK, once the person has approved it in Guardian. Guardian issues the capability and runs the approved call with its original arguments (it can change the target system), then returns ALLOW with the execution record. Before approval it returns ASK again and runs nothing; a denied, expired or unknown requestId returns DENY with a reasonCode; Guardian unreachable fails closed (SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) and can be retried. An approval is used once: claiming the same requestId again does not run the call a second time.

requestId.description: The requestId that guardian_invoke_tool returned with decision ASK. Starts with req_.

name: guardian_claim
title: Run an approved request
